name: PrintVault
description: PrintVault is a self-hosted library for your 3D print files. Store STL/3MF/OBJ/GCODE files, preview models in the browser with a Three.js viewer, track what you have printed, keep photos of finished prints, and save the printer settings, notes and source URL for every model. Paste a link from Thingiverse, Printables, MakerWorld or Cults3D and PrintVault imports the metadata for you.

notes.text: PrintVault has no built-in authentication and is intended for a trusted LAN. Put it behind a reverse proxy with auth if you expose it externally.
Optional: add a free Thingiverse app token (THINGIVERSE_TOKEN) to /etc/systemd/system/printvault.service to enable full Thingiverse imports including model files and photos.
Your models, photos and database live in /opt/printvault-data and are preserved across updates.
